BsodCodes.IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL: A driver accessed paged memory at too high an IRQL — typically a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.MEMORY_MANAGEMENT: Severe memory management error — often caused by faulty RAM or a driver.
BsodCodes.KMODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED: An exception in the kernel wasn't handled — driver or hardware incompatibility.
BsodCodes.NTFS_FILE_SYSTEM: Error in the NTFS driver — check the disk (chkdsk) and SATA cables.
BsodCodes.RDR_FILE_SYSTEM: Error in the network file redirector (SMB).
BsodCodes.DATA_BUS_ERROR: Memory parity error — almost certainly faulty RAM/hardware.
BsodCodes.CACHE_MANAGER: Error in the cache manager — usually insufficient pool memory.
BsodCodes.NO_MORE_IRP_STACK_LOCATIONS: A driver sent an IRP with insufficient stack — a faulty driver in the chain.
BsodCodes.SYSTEM_SERVICE_EXCEPTION: Exception in a system service — frequently a graphics driver or antivirus.
BsodCodes.MULTIPLE_IRP_COMPLETE_REQUESTS: A driver completed the same IRP twice — a clear driver bug.
BsodCodes.PFN_LIST_CORRUPT: Corrupted physical page list — faulty RAM or a driver writing out of bounds.
BsodCodes.PAGE_FAULT_IN_NONPAGED_AREA: Invalid memory access from the kernel — faulty driver, RAM, or antivirus.
BsodCodes.REGISTRY_ERROR: Registry error — corrupted hive or a disk problem.
BsodCodes.KERNEL_DATA_INPAGE_ERROR: Couldn't read a page from the page file — faulty disk/cable/controller.
BsodCodes.INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE: Windows can no longer see the boot disk — SATA mode changed in BIOS or missing storage driver.
BsodCodes.SYSTEM_THREAD_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED: Unhandled exception in a system thread — the driver in the stack trace is the suspect.
BsodCodes.UNEXPECTED_KERNEL_MODE_TRAP: Unexpected kernel trap (often a double fault) — overclocking, RAM, or a driver.
BsodCodes.NMI_HARDWARE_FAILURE: Non-maskable hardware interrupt — a hardware fault reported by the board.
BsodCodes.KERNEL_MODE_EXCEPTION_NOT_HANDLED: Unhandled kernel exception — typically a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.DRIVER_POWER_STATE_FAILURE: A driver blocked a power transition (sleep/resume) — often a network/GPU/USB driver.
BsodCodes.ACPI_BIOS_ERROR: The ACPI BIOS is reporting invalid data — update the BIOS.
BsodCodes.ATTEMPTED_SWITCH_FROM_DPC: Illegal context switch from a DPC — a driver bug.
BsodCodes.ATTEMPTED_WRITE_TO_READONLY_MEMORY: A driver wrote to read-only memory — a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.BAD_POOL_CALLER: Incorrect pool allocation/deallocation — a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.DRIVER_VERIFIER_DETECTED_VIOLATION: Driver Verifier caught a driver red-handed — the parameters point to the driver.
BsodCodes.DRIVER_CORRUPTED_EXPOOL: Pool corrupted by a driver writing after it was freed.
BsodCodes.DRIVER_VERIFIER_IOMANAGER_VIOLATION: Driver Verifier: violation at the I/O Manager level.
BsodCodes.DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL: A driver accessed paged memory at a high IRQL — parameter 4 shows the driver.
BsodCodes.POOL_CORRUPTION_IN_FILE_AREA: Pool corruption in the file area.
BsodCodes.WORKER_THREAD_RETURNED_AT_BAD_IRQL: A worker thread returned at the wrong IRQL — a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.MANUALLY_INITIATED_CRASH: Crash triggered manually (CrashOnCtrlScroll) — not an actual failure.
BsodCodes.CRITICAL_PROCESS_DIED: A critical Windows process (csrss/wininit) died — corrupted system files or a disk issue.
BsodCodes.CRITICAL_OBJECT_TERMINATION: A critical object terminated unexpectedly — often a dying disk/SSD.
BsodCodes.FLTMGR_FILE_SYSTEM: Error in the Filter Manager — usually an antivirus filter.
BsodCodes.ATTEMPTED_EXECUTE_OF_NOEXECUTE_MEMORY: Code execution from non-executable memory — a faulty driver or RAM.
BsodCodes.BUGCODE_USB_DRIVER: Error in the USB driver — a faulty USB device/hub/driver.
BsodCodes.CRITICAL_STRUCTURE_CORRUPTION: PatchGuard: the kernel was modified — an illegal driver or faulty RAM.
BsodCodes.VIDEO_TDR_FAILURE: The graphics card stopped responding and the reset failed — GPU driver or faulty card.
BsodCodes.VIDEO_TDR_TIMEOUT_DETECTED: Timeout while resetting the graphics card (TDR) — GPU driver/overheating.
BsodCodes.VIDEO_SCHEDULER_INTERNAL_ERROR: Internal error in the video scheduler — GPU driver.
BsodCodes.WHEA_UNCORRECTABLE_ERROR: Fatal hardware error reported by the CPU (WHEA) — CPU/motherboard/power supply, often overclocking.
BsodCodes.FAULTY_HARDWARE_CORRUPTED_PAGE: Memory page corrupted by hardware — faulty RAM (run the RAM test in SMDWin).
BsodCodes.DPC_WATCHDOG_VIOLATION: A driver spent too long at a high IRQL — often a storage driver (SSD firmware) or network driver.
BsodCodes.KERNEL_SECURITY_CHECK_FAILURE: Structure corruption detected by the kernel — a faulty driver or RAM.
BsodCodes.KERNEL_MODE_HEAP_CORRUPTION: Corrupted kernel heap — a faulty driver.
BsodCodes.UNEXPECTED_STORE_EXCEPTION: Exception in the compressed memory store — often SSD/storage driver related.

Glossary.package_power: Total power drawn by the whole processor chip (cores, built-in graphics, memory controller). It rises when the processor works hard.
Glossary.clock_now: Current speed of the processor. It rises under load and drops when idle to save power.
Glossary.vram: Video memory: the memory on the graphics card used for images and textures.
Glossary.trim: Tells an SSD which blocks are no longer used so it can clean them in advance and stay fast. Safe to run. Not needed for hard disks.
Glossary.file_system_check: Scans the disk's file structure for errors. A scan only reads; repairs may need a restart.
Glossary.fast_startup: Saves part of Windows to disk at shutdown so the next start is faster. A normal shutdown then behaves like a partial hibernate.
Glossary.usb_selective_suspend: Lets Windows switch off idle USB ports to save power. Turn it off if a mouse, keyboard or USB device disconnects at random.
Glossary.boost: Lets the processor run faster than its base speed for short periods when power and temperature allow. Disabled means quieter and cooler, with lower peak speed.
Glossary.secure_boot: A firmware feature that lets only trusted software start at boot. Windows 11 asks for it; many older computers do not have it, and that is normal.
Glossary.tpm: A security chip that stores encryption keys. Windows 11 asks for it; many older computers do not have one, and that is normal.
Glossary.boot_mode: How the computer starts Windows: UEFI is the modern way, BIOS / MBR is the older one.
Glossary.jitter: How much the delay (ping) changes from one test packet to the next. Lower is better for calls and games.
Glossary.gateway: The router that connects this computer to the local network and the internet.
Glossary.dns: Turns website names into addresses. A slow DNS makes pages take longer to start loading.
Glossary.workgroup: Name of the simple home or office network group the computer belongs to. Usually WORKGROUP.
Glossary.processor_state_range: Lowest and highest processor speed, as a percentage of its maximum. Lowering the top value gives less heat and fan noise.
Glossary.throttling: The processor slowing itself down to avoid overheating or drawing too much power.
Glossary.sleep_s3: Sleep mode that keeps memory powered and switches off almost everything else. The computer wakes up fast.
Glossary.wake_timer: A scheduled task that is allowed to wake the computer from sleep, for example for updates or maintenance.
Glossary.smart: Health data that the disk reports about itself: errors, wear, temperature, hours of use.
Glossary.vcore: Voltage supplied to the processor cores. It changes with load.
Glossary.uptime: Time since the computer was last started.

SensorSetup.Title: Welcome to SMD Win
SensorSetup.Subtitle: One small step before you start
SensorSetup.CardText: To show temperatures, voltages and fan speeds, SMD Win needs a small driver that reads the sensors on your computer.
SensorSetup.Point3: Installed once — Windows asks for permission
SensorSetup.Details: The driver is called PawnIO. It is digitally signed and lets SMD Win read the processor and motherboard sensors safely. It replaces the older WinRing0 driver, which antivirus programs flag as a known weakness (CVE-2020-14979). Without it, SMD Win still works, but temperatures come from a limited source and voltages and fans are not shown. You can install it later from Settings.
SensorSetup.DoneSub: Temperatures, voltages and fans are now read directly.
